articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: How The Evolving Investment Story Could Reshape United Airlines Holdings (UAL) Fair Value. Analysts now peg fair value for United Airlines Holdings at about US$130.17 per share, compared with roughly US$132.67 previously, reflecting a relatively modest shift in the formal price target. The adjustment lines up with a mixed research tone, where confidence in premium demand and revenue quality is balanced against concerns around fuel costs, capacity, and the risk of guidance changes.
